content.scope: A transformation represents verified data movement or derivation inside or between modeled processors/entities. SQL is BE lineage notation, not a requirement that the runtime executes SQL.
rules: Review relevant UI, interaction, state, application/service, integration and data-access flows. Do not restrict transformations to processors with runtime SQL or to DAO/Repository.

Model meaningful field mappings, calculations, request arguments, returned results and state changes with beyond_add_transformation_by_sql over verified BE objects/attributes. BE records lineage; it does not execute this SQL.
Read current source/target attributes and transformations first. Reuse existing mappings and respect use_lookup: false means INPUT/OUTPUT only, not no transformations.

SELECT maps verified source results or caller inputs into current-processor results. INSERT into another processor maps arguments into its existing INPUT contract; it is not a database write at runtime.
Keep original runtime code/evidence distinct from the SQL representation. Use only supported SQL syntax and actual modeled fields; never invent fields, objects or SELECT 1 to draw a call.

Pure control calls, DDL and unrepresentable behavior require caller/target, conditions and code evidence in metadata/checkpoints. Record unresolved parser gaps instead of silently omitting them or submitting unavailable manual payload tools.
completion: Implementation/UX status updates to DESIGNED, DRAFT_IMPLEMENTED, TESTING, IMPLEMENTED or MODIFICATION_TESTING and new checkpoints return transformation_check. Inspect its warnings before reporting completion. Checkpoints check processors changed in the preceding checkpoint interval, within accessible canvases.
Compare the requested scope against relevant processors and verified data flows across layers. Report saved transformation IDs, reused mappings, justified exclusions and unresolved flows.
A successful SQL registration or completed analysis run proves only its submitted scope, not coverage of all required flows. Report PARTIAL when required flows remain unresolved.

patterns.returned_result: SELECT s.result AS result FROM BE_OBJECT('<source_processor_id>') s

content.pattern_note: Patterns are templates. Verify IDs, fields, nested contracts and target IO policy through MCP before use.
